mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO venue (id, room_name, assignment_id) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.roomName}, #{item.assignmentId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE room_name = VALUES(room_name), assignment_id = VALUES(assignment_id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_name AS roomName, assignment_id AS assignmentId FROM venue WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY id ASC
